nodes.description: The homozygous N-terminal missense alleles lower COG3 protein, and COG4 falls with it while COG1 and COG2 are preserved. The variants sit in the region COG3 uses to assemble with the other lobe A subunits, so the proposed lesion is destabilisation of lobe A. Remaining COG3 retains partial function: the allele is hypomorphic, not null. COG3 knockout cells show the same COG3-COG4 co-dependence, supporting it as a general property of lobe A rather than an allele-specific finding.
